label: Euthyphro modal approval test finite controls
paraphrase: General facts: robust due actuality gives supervenience; weak invariance is stable truth of every aspect over the nature-fixed profiles; under approval as ground, invariance is equivalent to approvals fixed by natures; the rigidified account excludes the transfer bridge; command-constituted obligation with nature-fixed command variation is not invariant. The premise bundle of the extensional step is equivalent to the extensional approval failure, and given invariance and variation the transfer bridge alone is; with excluded middle the due thesis gives the weak approval premise. Fixed artifact models: a divine joint model (whose only nature-fixed profile is the base, so its modal conjuncts are degenerate), a human-assessor model, a rigidified model, a voluntarist model and a modified command model (a non-degenerate divine instance with a nature-fixed variant and a non-vacuous goodness constraint on commands). These are formal interpretations, not metaphysical possibility claims.
